result.title: Spatio-Temporal Multi-Order Interaction for Video Recognition
result.summary: Many temporal approaches for video recognition rely on explicit cross-channel aggregation projections, which have quadratic complexity in the number of channels, introducing significant computational overhead. In addition, the spatio-temporal representation used for video recognition is biased either toward local order interactions (for CNNs) or toward global order interactions (for transformers). Starting from the multi-order spatial representation of MogaNet, our method introduces two complementary contributions to tackle these problems. First, for the temporal modelling, we introduce parallel multi-order processing with depthwise-only convolutions and implicit gating-based aggregation, which is linear in the number of channels, inducing a considerable computational reduction. Second, we propose a dual interaction between spatial and temporal dimensions, which allows a better spatio-temporal representation without increasing the computational cost. By combining these two contributions, our proposed VideoMogaNet achieves performance on par with or better than state-of-the-art action recognition approaches across multiple video benchmarks (UCF101, HMDB51, Kinetics-400, Diving48), while considerably reducing the cost of the temporal branch.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究视频动作识别的时空表示，用纯深度可分离卷积与隐式门控聚合实现线性的多阶时序建模，并提出空间-时间双交互以在不增加开销的情况下改进表示，在多个视频基准上取得与 SOTA 相当的结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是纯视觉骨干的效率与表示阶数问题，既无 LVR 式的内部推理状态生成与更新，也不涉及证据筛选、停止决策或答案对 latent 内容的使用，未提供可核查的具体借鉴线索。
